title.ja: 図1-1 角交換四間飛車の基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form of Bishop Exchange Fourth File Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1は角交換四間飛車の基本形です。ここから逆棒銀で攻めていく手順を見ていきます。基本形までの指し方は別の記事で解説しています。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is the basic position of Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook. We will look at how to attack with the Reverse Climbing Silver from here. How to reach the basic position is explained in another article.

section.ja: 角交換四間飛車の基本形
section.en: Basic form of Bishop Exchange Fourth File Rook

title.ja: 図1-2 片美濃囲いに組む
title.en: Figure 1-2: Build Single Mino

explain.ja: 逆棒銀を狙うときは、素早く片美濃囲いに組んで速攻を狙うのが基本です。囲いができたら一気に攻めましょう。
explain.en: When aiming for the Reverse Climbing Silver, the basic approach is to quickly build a Half Mino castle and attack fast. Once the castle is done, go on the offensive at once.

section.ja: 片美濃囲いに組む
section.en: Build a Half Mino castle

title.ja: 図1-3 向かい飛車に振りなおす
title.en: Figure 1-3: Re-swing to Opposing Rook

explain.ja: 逆棒銀で攻めるときは、飛車を向かい飛車に振り直します。ここから8筋を攻めていくのが逆棒銀の基本です。
explain.en: To attack with the Reverse Climbing Silver, re-range the rook to Opposing Rook. Attacking on the 8th file from here is the basic idea of the Reverse Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 向かい飛車に振りなおす
section.en: Re-swing to Opposing Rook

title.ja: 図a-1 ダイレクト向かい飛車の変化
title.en: Figure a-1: Variation of Direct Opposing Rook

explain.ja: 逆棒銀では、一度四間飛車に振ってから向かい飛車に振り直します。それなら最初から向かい飛車にすればよいと思うかもしれませんが、いきなり向かい飛車にすると△4五角と打つ変化が生まれます。これはダイレクト向かい飛車という形でまだ互角ですが、難解な手順も多く、初心者にはあまりおすすめできません。
explain.en: In the Reverse Climbing Silver you first range to the Fourth-File Rook and then re-range to Opposing Rook. You might think it is better to play Opposing Rook from the start, but doing so directly allows the variation with the bishop drop △4五角. This is called Direct Opposing Rook; it is still even, but it has many difficult lines and is not recommended for beginners.

section.ja: 向かい飛車に振りなおす
section.en: Re-swing to Opposing Rook

title.ja: 図2-1 8筋から逆襲するのが逆棒銀
title.en: Figure 2-1: Counterattacking from the 8th file is Reverse Climbing Silver

explain.ja: 図1-3から、相手がぼんやりしていると▲8六歩からの逆棒銀の仕掛けが成立します。図2-1からは、銀をどんどん前に進めて相手の飛車を圧迫していくのが狙いです。相手が8筋を詰めてきたはずなのに、こちらが逆に8筋を攻める展開になっています。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-3, if the opponent is careless, the Reverse Climbing Silver attack starting with ▲8六歩 works. From Diagram 2-1 the aim is to keep pushing the silver forward and pressure the opponent's rook. The opponent had been pressing on the 8th file, but now it is you who attack on the 8th file.

section.ja: 8筋からの逆襲を狙う
section.en: Aiming for a counterattack on the 8th file

title.ja: 図2-2 高く歩で押さえておけば優勢
title.en: Figure 2-2: Holding it down with a high pawn is advantageous

explain.ja: 相手は慌てて△7四歩から△7三銀として8筋に利きを足してきますが、落ち着いて▲8四歩と打っておけば十分です。相手の飛車がかなり使いにくくなっているのがわかります。
explain.en: The opponent hurriedly adds support on the 8th file with △7四歩 and △7三銀, but calmly dropping a pawn with ▲8四歩 is enough. You can see that the opponent's rook has become very hard to use.

section.ja: 銀をズンズン進めて相手の飛車を攻める
section.en: Push the silver steadily forward to attack the opponent's rook

title.ja: 図2-3 角で駒を足す
title.en: Figure 2-3: Gain material with the bishop

explain.ja: 図2-2からさらに攻めるなら、7筋の歩を突き捨ててから▲5六角と打ちます。次の▲8三歩成が相手には受けにくい狙いです。▲8六歩から銀を進めて、あっという間に振り飛車が優勢になりました。
explain.en: To keep attacking from Diagram 2-2, push the 7th-file pawn as a sacrifice and then drop the bishop with ▲5六角. The next threat, ▲8三歩成, is hard for the opponent to meet. Starting with ▲8六歩 and advancing the silver, the Ranging Rook side quickly gained the advantage.

section.ja: 銀をズンズン進めて相手の飛車を攻める
section.en: Push the silver steadily forward to attack the opponent's rook

title.ja: 図3-1 あらかじめ7筋の歩を突くのが受け
title.en: Figure 3-1: Pushing the 7th-file pawn in advance is the defense

explain.ja: 図1-3から、相手が工夫してきた場合を見ます。逆棒銀に対しては、あらかじめ△7四歩と突いておくのが手筋で、これで単純な攻めは受けられてしまいます。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-3, let us see what happens if the opponent plays more cleverly. Against the Reverse Climbing Silver, the tesuji is to play △7四歩 in advance, which stops the simple attack.

section.ja: 相手が7筋の歩を突いてきたら?
section.en: What if the opponent pushes the 7th-file pawn?

title.ja: 図3-2 桂跳ねで逆棒銀が受けられる
title.en: Figure 3-2: Reverse Climbing Silver is defended with a knight jump

explain.ja: △7四歩と突かれた場合、単純な攻めは成立しません。▲8六歩と仕掛けても、桂馬を跳ねて受けられてしまいます。これでは振り飛車に攻め手がなくなってしまいます。
explain.en: If the opponent has played △7四歩, the simple attack does not work. Even if you start with ▲8六歩, the opponent defends by jumping the knight. That leaves the Ranging Rook side with no attack.

section.ja: シンプルな逆棒銀は、桂跳ねで受けられる
section.en: A simple Reverse Bouginu can be met with a knight jump

title.ja: 図3-3 争点を7筋に移す
title.en: Figure 3-3: Move the point of contention to the 7th file

explain.ja: 図3-1に戻って別の指し手を見ます。相手が△7四歩と突いてきたときは、8筋ではなく7筋に攻めの争点を移し、▲6六銀と銀を使っていきます。通常の四間飛車では6六に歩があることが多いので、▲6六銀は角交換四間飛車ならではの手です。
explain.en: Going back to Diagram 3-1, let us look at another move. When the opponent has played △7四歩, shift the point of attack from the 8th file to the 7th file and use the silver with ▲6六銀. In the normal Fourth-File Rook a pawn usually stands on 6六, so ▲6六銀 is a move unique to Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook.

section.ja: 7筋から歩を取って、▲7二歩の叩き
section.en: Take a pawn on the 7th file, then the ▲7二歩 peck

title.ja: 図3-4 歩を1枚手持ちに
title.en: Figure 3-4: Keep one pawn in hand

explain.ja: ▲7五歩から歩を1枚交換しに行きます。これで持ち駒に歩が入り、さまざまな攻め手が生まれます。
explain.en: Go and trade one pawn starting with ▲7五歩. This gets a pawn in hand, which opens up various attacking options.

section.ja: 7筋から歩を取って、▲7二歩の叩き
section.en: Take a pawn on the 7th file, then the ▲7二歩 peck

title.ja: 図3-5 ▲7二歩の叩きが手筋
title.en: Figure 3-5: The ▲7二歩 tap is the tesuji

explain.ja: 歩を1枚持ったら、▲7二歩と叩くのが手筋です。放っておくと▲7一歩成からじわじわ攻められるので、相手はこの歩を何とか処理しなければなりません。
explain.en: Once you have a pawn in hand, the tesuji is to strike with ▲7二歩. If left alone, it leads to ▲7一歩成 and a gradual attack, so the opponent has to deal with this pawn somehow.

section.ja: 7筋から歩を取って、▲7二歩の叩き
section.en: Take a pawn on the 7th file, then the ▲7二歩 peck

title.ja: 図3-6 飛車の利きをずらして攻める
title.en: Figure 3-6: Attack by shifting the rook's line

explain.ja: 相手は△7二飛と飛車で歩を取りましたが、そこで▲8六歩からの攻めが決まります。飛車先がそれたため8筋ががら空きになりました。相手が慌てて△8二飛と戻しても、▲8五歩と取り込んでいけば十分です。▲7二歩と叩く手筋は振り飛車でよく出てくるので、ぜひ覚えておきましょう。
explain.en: The opponent took the pawn with the rook by △7二飛, but then the attack starting with ▲8六歩 works. With the rook diverted, the 8th file is wide open. Even if the opponent hurriedly returns with △8二飛, capturing in with ▲8五歩 is enough. The ▲7二歩 strike is a tesuji that appears often in Ranging Rook play, so be sure to remember it.

section.ja: 7筋から歩を取って、▲7二歩の叩き
section.en: Take a pawn on the 7th file, then the ▲7二歩 peck

title.ja: 図3-7 腰掛け銀の構え
title.en: Figure 3-7: Reclining Silver setup

explain.ja: 図3-1に戻り、別の指し手を見ます。今度は相手が△6四歩と突いてきました。この手は腰掛け銀の形に構えつつ、△6五歩から飛車のコビンを開けて角を打ち込む攻めを狙っています。
explain.en: Going back to Diagram 3-1, let us look at another move. This time the opponent played △6四歩. This sets up a Rapid Advance Silver formation while aiming at △6五歩, opening the rook's diagonal weak point and then dropping a bishop to attack.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図3-8 やはり歩を一枚手持ちにする
title.en: Figure 3-8: Again keep one pawn in hand

explain.ja: やはり7筋の歩を交換して歩を持ち駒にするのがセオリーです。今度は7四の地点に相手の駒の利きがないので、次に▲7四歩などと打てれば振り飛車がかなり指しやすくなります。△7四歩で銀が弾かれる心配もありません。
explain.en: Again, the standard plan is to trade pawns on the 7th file and get a pawn in hand. This time no opposing piece covers the point 7四, so if you can follow with a drop like ▲7四歩, the Ranging Rook side is much better. There is also no worry about the silver being repelled by △7四歩.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図3-9 このタイミングでの角打ち
title.en: Figure 3-9: Bishop drop at this timing

explain.ja: このタイミングで△4四角と打ってくるのが嫌らしい手です。振り飛車の対応としては、▲6六角や▲7七角と角を合わせる手や、▲6六銀と引く手が考えられます。どの手が良いのでしょうか。
explain.en: At this moment the bishop drop △4四角 is an annoying move. The Ranging Rook side could respond by matching bishops with ▲6六角 or ▲7七角, or by retreating the silver with ▲6六銀. Which is best?

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図3-10 角を合わせてから銀を引く
title.en: Figure 3-10: Align the bishops, then retreat the silver

explain.ja: ここでは▲6六角と合わせるのが好手です。この局面まで進むと、互いに攻め手がなくなってくるので囲いに手を付けていきます。ただし、囲いに手を付ける前に指しておきたい手があります。▲6六角以外の手については補足で解説しています。
explain.en: Matching with ▲6六角 is the good move here. After this position, both sides run out of attacks and start working on their castles. However, there is a move to play before touching the castle. The moves other than ▲6六角 are explained in the supplement.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図3-11 相手に歩を使わせておく
title.en: Figure 3-11: Make the opponent use up a pawn

explain.ja: 一度▲7八飛と回って、相手に歩を使わせておきます。その後もう一度8筋に飛車を戻してから駒組みを進めます。細かい手ですが、これで相手の持ち歩がなくなります。
explain.en: First swing the rook to 7八 with ▲7八飛 to make the opponent use up a pawn. Afterwards return the rook to the 8th file and continue developing. It is a small point, but it leaves the opponent with no pawn in hand.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図b-1 △4四角に▲6六銀
title.en: Figure b-1: ▲6六銀 against △4四角

explain.ja: 図3-9から別の手を見ます。ここで▲6六銀と引くと、△6五歩が痛烈です。▲7七銀と引くしかありませんが、そこで△7六歩の追撃があります。
explain.en: Let us look at another move from Diagram 3-9. Retreating with ▲6六銀 here runs into the severe △6五歩. You are forced to retreat with ▲7七銀, but then △7六歩 follows up the attack.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図b-2 △4四角に▲7七角
title.en: Figure b-2: ▲7七角 against △4四角

explain.ja: 図3-9から▲7七角と合わせるのも失敗です。△同角成、▲同桂に△7四歩と打たれると、桂馬が死んでしまいます。
explain.en: Matching bishops with ▲7七角 from Diagram 3-9 is also a mistake. After △同角成, ▲同桂, the drop △7四歩 traps the knight and it is lost.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図b-2 △4四角に▲6六角、△同角、▲同歩
title.en: Figure b-2: ▲6六角, △同角, ▲同歩 against △4四角

explain.ja: 図3-9から、▲6六角、△同角、▲同歩と進める手もあまり良くありません。△6七角と角を打ち込まれる隙ができてしまいます。
explain.en: From Diagram 3-9, continuing with ▲6六角, △同角, ▲同歩 is not good either. It leaves a hole for the bishop drop △6七角.

section.ja: 腰掛け銀の駒組みとの戦い
section.en: Fighting the Koshikake Gin piece setup

title.ja: 図4-1 飛車先不突き型
title.en: Figure 4-1: Form without pushing the rook-file pawn

explain.ja: 図4-1は、角交換四間飛車に対して居飛車が飛車先不突き型にしてきた局面です。居飛車は△8五歩と突く手を保留しているのが特徴で、これによって逆棒銀の▲8六歩の仕掛けを封じています。この形では逆棒銀で攻めることはできないので注意しましょう。飛車先不突き型との戦いについては、参考になる書籍もあります。
explain.en: Diagram 4-1 shows the position where the Static Rook side has chosen the setup that holds back the rook-file pawn against Bishop Exchange Fourth-File Rook. Its feature is that △8五歩 is withheld, which prevents the Reverse Climbing Silver attack starting with ▲8六歩. You cannot attack with the Reverse Climbing Silver in this formation, so be careful. A book is also available that covers how to fight this setup.

section.ja: 飛車先不突き型には...?
section.en: Against the unpushed rook pawn type...?
